name: Waste2Wealth
tagline: Pays crypto to people who report, clean and verify litter, with photos checked by AI and one account per human.
problem: Litter reports go nowhere because nobody has an incentive to clean.
solution: Photo report, claim and clean, community vote, automatic on-chain payout on a test network; Cloudinary vision prompts verify before and after photos and World ID gates accounts.
demo_moment: Team-described: report a pile, mark it cleaned and see the payouts.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Combines three sponsor platforms in one loop.

lessons: An incentive loop explains itself in one diagram.
